title: Tensor coefficient-resolution square in scalar coordinates
statement:
Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\varphi:A\to B$ a homomorphism of finite commutative rings. Work in the ordinary uncompleted unbounded pro-etale module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules, def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Fix canonical tensor models $a_Y,a_X$, with their representative maps and canonical tensor/pullback comparison $\tau$ [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Write $E_Z,T_Z,r_Z$ for ordinary scalar extension, its derived functor and exact restriction, and $h_Z:r_ZT_Z\simeq(-)\otimes^{\mathbf L}_{A_Z}B_Z$ for the normalized scalar-to-tensor isomorphism [det-sp-scalar-extension-functor, def-sp-proetale-scalar-mate-identifications]. Let $t$ be a natural ordinary tensor/pullback isomorphism satisfying the pure-unit-section formula of [lem-sp-proetale-scalar-balancing-chain]. Define $c_{t,P}$ degreewise as $f_A^*e_Y;t;e_X^{-1}$, as in [lem-sp-scalar-chain-counit-square]. For any flat-term K-flat complex $P$ [def-pc-kflat-complex, def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], put $F=f_A^*$ and $d_Z(P)=r_Z(\varepsilon_Z(P))$ followed by the exact restriction factor, with the universal scalar counit $\varepsilon_Z$. Write $\lambda_C:FQC\simeq QFC$ for exact pullback factors and $v:FB_Y[0]\simeq B_X[0]$ for the canonical coefficient pullback fixed by constant sections [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map]. Then
$$F(h_Y^{-1}(QP);d_Y(P));\lambda_{r_YE_YP};Q(c_{t,P})=\tau_{QP,B_Y[0]};a_X(1,v);h_X^{-1}(FQP);r_X(T_X(\lambda_P);\varepsilon_X(FP));\lambda^{r_X}_{E_XFP}.$$
Composition is written in order by $;$. This statement concerns the fixed K-flat first input and the tensor coefficient-resolution square; it contains no geometric scalar mate or derived restriction/pullback comparison. No flatness of B over A is required.

proof.text: Resolve B_Y[0] by a flat-term K-flat H and use the existing coefficient-resolution square on (P,H). K-flatness makes both coefficient-resolution maps quasi-isomorphisms after tensoring; pullback preserves the resolving class.

The scalar-to-tensor normalization rewrites the alpha coordinates as the scalar counits and ordinary tensor identifications. Balancing-chain uniqueness and its degree-zero total formula identify the lower map with c_t. Cancel the localized coefficient-resolution maps, and use naturality of h_X at the pullback factor of P.

theorem scalarTensorRepresentativeSquare
    {A B : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [Finite A] [Finite B]
    (φ : A →+* B) {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (aY : ProEtaleTensorModel Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A))
    (aX : ProEtaleTensorModel X (proEtaleConstantRing X A))
    (t : scalarMateOrdinaryTensor φ Y ⋙ proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f ≅
      proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f ⋙ scalarMateOrdinaryTensor φ X)
    (ht : IsScalarBalancing φ f t)
    (P : CochainComplex (proEtaleRingModules Y (proEtaleConstantRing Y A)) ℤ)
    (hp : CochainComplex.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat.{u + 1, u}
      (R := proEtaleConstantRing Y A) P)
    (hf : ∀ i : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite.{u + 1, u, u + 1, u + 1}
      (J := ProEt.topology Y) (R := proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (P.X i)) :
    (proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).map
      ((scalarMateDerivedTensorIso φ Y aY).inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) ≫
        (scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategory.map
          (scalarExtensionFunctorCounit φ Y P) ≫
        (scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
          ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≫
      (proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        (((scalarMateRestriction φ Y).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
          ((reductionChangeComplex Y (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := Y) φ)).obj P)) ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (scalarTensorChainIso φ f t P).hom =
    (proEtaleCanonicalTensorComparison f
      (proEtaleConstantRing Y A) (proEtaleConstantRing X A)
      (proEtaleConstantRingComparison f A) aY aX).hom.app
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj (scalarMateCoefficientComplex φ Y)) ≫
      aX.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom
        (𝟙 ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)))
        (scalarMateDerivedCoefficientPullback φ f).hom) ≫
      (scalarMateDerivedTensorIso φ X aX).inv.app
        ((proEtaleConstantRingDerivedPullback A f).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P)) ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((directImageScalarExtension φ X).map
          ((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app P) ≫
          scalarExtensionFunctorCounit φ X
            (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)) ≫
      (scalarMateRestriction φ X).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app
        ((reductionChangeComplex X (proEtaleConstantRingMap (T := X) φ)).obj
          (((proEtaleConstantRingPullback A f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P))
